type:
∀ {m : ℕ} (r : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) (p : (Fin (m + 1) →₀ ℕ) → Prop)
  [inst : DecidablePred p] {i : ℕ},
  i ≤ r (Fin.last m) →
    {d ∈ Roth.box (r ∘ Fin.castSucc) | p (Finsupp.mapDomain Fin.castSucc d + Finsupp.single (Fin.last m) i)}.card =
      {d ∈ Finset.filter p (Roth.box r) | d (Fin.last m) = i}.card
